date: Nov 14, 2026 · Week 1 / Day 6 · Visibility & early risk communication

cards.title: Escalate before the margin vanishes
cards.question: PCIe margin fell from 1.2 to 0.6 dB across builds. What do you tell the program team now?
cards.selfCheck: Report trend, consequence and confidence before root cause is known. Exercise: state an owner, a repeat measurement and a 24-hour decision checkpoint.
cards.prompt: Coach my 25-second Principal Engineer escalation for PCIe Gen5 margin trending 1.2 to 0.6 dB across builds. Challenge my impact statement, uncertainty, owner and deadline.

cards.title: Make the mismatch testable
cards.question: TDR and EM disagree by 2 Ω. What evidence would change your recommendation?
cards.selfCheck: Distinguish launch/de-embedding error from actual geometry variation. Exercise: name the discriminating measurement, pass criterion and when to revisit signoff.
cards.prompt: Role-play an SI signoff review for a 2-ohm EM versus TDR mismatch. Make me state hypotheses, decisive test, acceptance criterion and confidence.

cards.title: Don't let the PDN risk bounce teams
cards.question: A 19 MHz impedance peak crosses VRM, board and package boundaries. Who owns closure?
cards.selfCheck: Appoint one integrator, with explicit inputs from each team. Exercise: send a three-sentence request for transient evidence, accountable owners and due date.
cards.prompt: Help me write a concise cross-functional closure request for a 19 MHz PDN peak, assigning integrator and VRM, board and package deliverables.

cards.title: Protect the decision window
cards.question: A 3 dB NEXT miss has two fixes: reroute now or validate a shield. How do you frame it?
cards.selfCheck: Compare margin, validation effort and freeze impact; recommend a reversible next step. Exercise: ask layout and PM for a decision by a named checkpoint.
cards.prompt: Run a 60-second crosstalk mitigation tradeoff drill: reroute versus shielding before layout freeze. Score my recommendation, tradeoff clarity and decision ask.

cards.title: Can your update survive a director's interruption?
cards.question: A director asks, 'Are we safe to freeze?' while four SI/PI risks remain open. What is your answer?
cards.selfCheck: Lead with a conditional go/no-go recommendation; name top risk, evidence gap, owner and next checkpoint. Exercise: deliver it in 30 seconds without hiding uncertainty.
cards.prompt: Act as a skeptical hardware director. Interrupt my 30-second layout-freeze update covering PCIe margin, EM/TDR mismatch, PDN peak and crosstalk. Score my clarity, calibration, ownership and decision framing.
